broadcast_range.description: Optional range in blocks. When set, a broadcast play sound is delivered to players within this range of the sound. The effective range is capped by the player's view distance: players who are not within the sound's range and do not have the surrounding chunks loaded will not hear it, regardless of how large this value is.

sound_event_name.description: The namespaced sound event ID used to play this sound.

tags.description: Optional pack-defined key-value tags. Each value may be a single string or an array of strings.
